confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because Seoul lodging prices vary widely by district and season. Converted at roughly 1,400 KRW per USD. FX: the 0.6955 observation is for 2026-10-15, as shown on the RBA exchange-rates statistics page and homepage in search results. A 2026-10-16 figure (0.6947) appeared only on a third-party site, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Seoul's mid-tier price levels, benchmarked informally against Tokyo and Busan for restaurant, bar and lodging tiers. No city-specific listings were inspected.
